name: Merge Designs [Psionic]
body:
Your tattoo designs are altered to disguise their nature and to be more compact.

Prerequisites: Scribe Tattoo, pattern designs class feature.

Benefit: Your tattoos cannot be interpreted to determine your powers known. In addition, you can safely wear one additional psionic tattoo on your body.

normal: Tattoos for the pattern designs class feature can be identified by a Spellcraft check. A character can only safely wear twenty psionic tattoos.
